adopt: Pair a phone with a Steam Deck and start a stream, then read back which route it used.
description:

Problem
Streaming a game from a Steam Deck to a phone means pairing two apps by hand, guessing which address the Deck is on today, and finding out it routed through the internet only when it stutters.
